verdict.rationale: Superhuman docs confirm read-status tracking ('check which emails have been read', 'Read statuses are now shared across your team') and community evidence (superhuman-comm-1, criticizing image-based tracking as 'spying') independently corroborates that read/open tracking is a real, functioning feature. However, no evidence explicitly confirms a timestamped 'when opened' view for individual recipients—only binary read/unread status and team-level sharing are documented. Missing for 10: explicit per-recipient open-time timestamps, hands-on verification of accuracy/reliability of the read-tracking mechanism.
